summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Ermenegildo Zegna N.V., a foreign private issuer, announcing the publication of the convocation notice for its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) to be held on June 26, 2026. The board recommends a dividend distribution of €0.12 per ordinary share, totaling approximately €32 million, subject to shareholder approval. The filing includes standard AGM materials and statutory audited financial statements. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is described. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation catalyst.
